# Samples, scans and deviations

> what is scanned, and what a person decides when something is wrong with a sample

**Types:** `Sample`, `Scan`, `Deviation`, `SampleDeviation` (packages Samples, Deviations)

**Commands in:** Confirm, Open, Register, Resolve, Scan

**Events out:** Analysed, Collected, Delivered, DeviationConfirmed, DeviationPending, DeviationResolved, Haemolysed, Missing, Packed, PickedUp, Queued, Received, Rejected, Released

**Policies reacting:** scans_to_handlings (on Collected, Packed, PickedUp, Delivered, Received, Rejected, Queued, Analysed, Released); open_deviation (on Haemolysed, Missing); hold_for_deviation (on DeviationPending); release_on_resolve (on DeviationResolved); deviation_to_handlings (on DeviationConfirmed); patient_collected (on Collected); patient_in_transit (on PickedUp); patient_at_lab (on Received)

## Rules

<a id="R7"></a>
### R7 — Every status comes from a scan on the sample

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

A scan names the sample, what happened and where. The sample does not know which tasks it is on: every handling of it gets the scan and decides what it means. The scan's own id makes a resent scan harmless.

- **Model:** `Sample`, `scans_to_handlings`
- **Shown by:** 01-two-tubes-to-the-lab, 09-a-late-scan-never-moves-the-patient-back

<a id="R8"></a>
### R8 — A deviation holds the step until a person decides

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

Haemolysed or missing, reported at a site, holds the sample's steps there. Resolved — it did not happen — the step goes on; confirmed, the step fails and the sample stops.

- **Model:** `Handling.open on DeviationPending`, `Handling.open.on_hold on DeviationResolved`, `SampleDeviation`, `open_deviation`, `hold_for_deviation`, `release_on_resolve`, `deviation_to_handlings`
- **Shown by:** 02-haemolysed-at-the-lab, 03-missing-on-delivery-then-found

<a id="R9"></a>
### R9 — A tube rejected on receipt fails the step at once

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

An unlabelled tube is rejected on receipt: no deviation, nobody to decide — the step fails and the sample stops.

- **Model:** `Handling.open on Rejected`
- **Shown by:** 10-rejected-on-receipt
